description: Region of Emilia-Romagna publishes the nine map sheets of Alta Via dei Parchi, a 500-kilometre walking itinerary in 27 stages through Emilia-Romagna, Tuscany and Marche. Trail-database and regional-cartography lineage is recorded. Coverage is Emilia-Romagna, Tuscany and Marche. The mapped itinerary can supply walking-network and access information for active-mobility simulations. The grouped resource has 9 native metadata entries; versions, map sheets and complementary representations are retained together where the provider defines the same resource. Native metadata states restricted use and intellectual-property conditions, without an open licence; individual distribution access and prices remain unverified. Metadata is publicly readable; charges for obtaining or using the underlying material are not established here. Access is through the linked native metadata, which lists the provider routes and declared formats. These are map products, with paper/geoportal representations and restricted reuse, not a verified routable digital network. One updated sheet also cites OpenStreetMap among its sources. Accuracy and current completeness remain unverified. No distribution, map, feature or document body was downloaded. Descriptive metadata dates range from 2013-07-23 to 2025-10-13; these dates are not treated as asset observation dates. Related regional or municipal inventories describe other physical assets or broader source catalogues.
